name: Senoo Ayami
source:
A first-year student who is a member of the string orchestra club and in charge of the cello. A year prior to her enrollment at the academy, she saw [url=/c32637]Nao[/url] playing at the school festival and was completely amazed by her performance, to the point of entering the same school and moving away from her parents' house - all for the sake of wanting to play together with Nao. She is also friends with [url=/c34094]Mai[/url].

Ayami is a shy and indecisive girl who has a hard time interacting with strangers, and easily gets stage fright, a habit she's been trying her best to combat against. Despite that, Ayami has amazing concentration skills, and completely loses track of her surroundings when she performs. She is also treated like a mascot between the other members of the string orchestra club, and they all love her a lot.
